# Sixteenth pass: moving scenes, full video (generated by scripts/make_stats_p23.py; declared in LOG.md)

TUM RGB-D, freiburg3 camera, 8 sequences with moving people and 5 static sequences, 200 frames in temporal order, consecutive windows of 10 frames. Unit: sequence (mean over its windows); paired sign-flip over sequences.

**Label validity.** Share of pixels labelled moving: 5.14% on the dynamic sequences, 0.161% on the static ones (every such pixel is label noise). The moving class is read (rule: static share at most a quarter of the dynamic share).
